scenes.subject: Iris violeta, rocío, oscuridad de estudio
scenes.image: Ultra-photorealistic extreme macro still of a single deep-violet iris petal emerging from absolute black studio background; realistic radial veins, tiny spherical dew droplets with believable surface tension, rich amethyst-purple pigment, one large clear droplet centered in the left third, exquisite texture, 100 mm macro lens look at high magnification, thin sharp focus plane, restrained cool rim-light from upper left and faint warm lower bounce; genuine optical bokeh, high-end botanical studio photography, landscape 16:9, no text, no graphics, no artificial CGI gloss.
scenes.video:
Premium extreme macro botanical cinematography. A single deep-violet iris against a seamless pure black background, with one perfectly formed transparent dew droplet resting on the front petal. Physically accurate petal microtexture and radial veins, refined studio rim lighting, rich violet tones, controlled specular highlights, realistic 100mm macro lens appearance, shallow but natural depth of field. Animate the provided reference image while preserving its exact iris geometry, petal positions, droplet shape, and composition.
ENTRY TRANSITION, 0–2 seconds: Begin with the exact composition of the provided reference image. Hold the iris geometry and droplet completely stable. Use a gentle, localized upper-left rim-light reveal across the existing petal; do not fade the whole image in from black. Camera remains locked on a tripod.
MAIN ACTION, 2–8 seconds: Keep a fixed camera and locked focus on the same attached droplet and its petal. Preserve their geometry and position. Show only subtle, physically plausible movement in the droplet's reflected studio highlight and a very gradual change in the violet rim light. Keep fine petal veins and the droplet's refracted texture visibly sharp. No zoom, no focus pull, no focus breathing.
EXIT TRANSITION, 8–10 seconds: Keep the droplet and petal crisp, fully visible, and unchanged. Create a restrained exit effect only in the surrounding black background: the violet rim-light halo gently narrows and recedes behind the flower without lowering exposure on the subject. Lock the final composition and hold it unchanged through 10 seconds. End on a clean, bright-enough, stable, detailed frame suitable for saving as the starting image of BB-002.
No morphing, no moving droplets, no duplicated petals, no flicker, no camera shake, no artificial glitter, no whole-frame fade, no subject blur, no text, no watermark.

scenes.subject: Orquídea púrpura, continuidad óptica
scenes.video:
Premium extreme macro botanical cinematography, 16:9. Animate the supplied BB-001 final frame as the exact opening composition. The incoming subject is one deep-violet iris petal with its attached transparent droplet on pure black. Preserve the petal anatomy and droplet shape; do not move or deform either. A separate, unmistakable purple Phalaenopsis orchid is revealed by a controlled studio-light transition. The finished composition must feature one clearly readable orchid bloom as the sole dominant subject, with clean black negative space between it and any remaining iris detail. Real botanical proportions, crisp papillae and veins, rich but restrained lilac-violet color, refined macro studio lighting, realistic 100mm macro optics.

ENTRY TRANSITION, 0–2 seconds: Match the supplied reference frame exactly. Hold its iris petal, attached droplet, framing, exposure, camera, and focus steady. A small cool-lilac highlight appears only on the far-right black background, introducing a new, separate orchid silhouette. No whole-frame fade, zoom, or focus pull.

MAIN ACTION, 2–8 seconds: Keep the camera, framing, and focus locked. Slowly move a narrow lilac studio key light across the separate orchid at frame right, revealing its recognizable Phalaenopsis lip, broad rounded petals, central column, natural veins, and surface texture. The orchid becomes the clear focal subject and occupies about 45–55% of the frame by 8 seconds. At the same time, let the original iris and droplet recede naturally into shadow at frame left without changing their shape. Maintain a visible strip of pure black between the two flowers. One orchid only; no cluster, no extra petals detached from the bloom, no flower overlap.

EXIT TRANSITION, 8–10 seconds: Finish on a stable, sharply detailed Phalaenopsis bloom at frame right, with its characteristic lip and central column plainly legible. Keep a small violet iris remnant dimly visible at far left only if it remains clearly separate; otherwise it may be concealed by natural shadow. Hold the orchid's color, geometry, focus, exposure, and composition unchanged through 10 seconds. End on a clean image suitable as the next clip's starting frame.

No morphing or species replacement, no blended flower anatomy, no overlapping blooms, no soft indistinct orchid, no camera movement, no focus breathing, no rack focus, no moving droplet, no duplicate flower, no flicker, no exposure pumping, no artificial glitter, no abrupt flash or full-frame fade, no text, no watermark.

The rose may remain as a dim but separate bloom near frame left. Add a soft amber highlight along a few real calendula petals, then hold a bright, sharp, stable final image suitable as BB-005's starting frame.

production_generation_strategy.primary_video_route: VideoExpress Create Video From Prompt, one generated BB-001 master still followed by sequential saved-last-frame references
sequence: generate and approve one BB-001 master still only
for BB-001 select that master still as the video reference; use the exact v3 timed prompt and render one 10-second clip
save the actual final frame via Media Library > My Videos > Save Last Frame; verify it appears in My AI Images
for each next clip, select only the immediately preceding clip's verified saved last frame as its starting reference; do not generate a separate scene still
render one dependent clip at a time, review it, save its final frame, then proceed to the next prompt
place finished clips directly adjacent on the timeline with no extra editor transition
generation_saving_rules: generate one master still for the entire chain unless a missing or unusable saved endpoint requires a documented replacement
reuse the immediately preceding verified endpoint for every clip after BB-001
do not generate separate scene stills when a saved frame can start the next clip
allow at most one targeted retry after recording and correcting a specific defect
production_generation_strategy.membership_policy: Use current included membership credits; do not buy top-ups, upgrades, or another subscription without explicit user authorization.
